answer: 340B savings are reinvested into the organization’s medical and behavioral health service lines to support the continued delivery of comprehensive care to our patients and community. These expenditures include personnel costs for providers, clinical support staff, care teams, and enabling staff who directly deliver or support patient care; supplies necessary for medical and behavioral health operations; and services directly tied to the operation, access, and sustainability of each service line. Using 340B savings in this manner allows the health center to maintain and expand access to primary care and behavioral health services, particularly for underserved and vulnerable patients, while supporting the overall objectives of the FQHC’s HRSA-approved scope of project.
